note: Provenance manifest for the canonical UCI Adult / Census Income archive and its two OpenML redistributions audited in this repository.

openml_adult_v1_did179.note: The version returned by sklearn.datasets.fetch_openml('adult') at default settings.
openml_adult_v1_did179.divergence_from_canonical: Four continuous features (age, capital-gain, capital-loss, hours-per-week) are silently discretized to 5-level ordinal bins {0,1,2,3,4}; row count and class balance otherwise match the canonical corpus exactly.

openml_adult_v3_did43898.divergence_from_canonical: Verified row-for-row identical to the canonical corpus with its 52 exact duplicate rows removed (48,842 -> 48,790); six columns renamed (hyphen to underscore). The de-duplication is undocumented in the dataset's OpenML metadata.
